season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/mack-landing ('Camping is allowed year-round at this venue.', 'Open year round. Quiet hours 10 p.m. to 6 a.m.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10391795 (notice 'Open year round'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/mack-landing ('spaces for campers, RVs (no hookups) and tents'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Drinking water per recreation.gov ('Potable water is available') and the Forest Service amenity list, though the Forest Service page's boilerplate further down says 'Potable water is not available at this site.' Boat ramp, picnic tables, campfire rings; host on site October-March.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10391795 ('Restrooms Non flushing toilets. Water Potable water is available.'; amenities Drinking Water, Vault Toilets, Boat Ramp, Campfire Rings, Picnic Tables) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/mack-landing (Amenities: 'Drinking water', 'Host onsite October - March', 'Toilets (non-flush)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: No advance reservations: a recreation.gov 'Scan & Pay' site (rule 'S&P Only'), paid on arrival with the recreation.gov app using the QR code on the site kiosk; cell service may be missing, so download the app first. The usual 14-day limit is lifted during general gun season, when the campground serves as a hunt camp.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/mack-landing ('THIS IS NOW A REC.GOV "SCAN & PAY" SITE', 'Mack Landing serves as a hunt camp during general gun season. The normal 14-day camping limit is not in effect during general gun season') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10391795 (facility_rules scanAndPay 'S&P Only'), read 2026-10-21

note: USFS campground about 10 miles NW of Sopchoppy on a ridge above the Ochlockonee River; picnic tables, fire rings and a concrete boat ramp, camp host October-March. Serves as a hunt camp during general gun season (camping still open to non-hunters). --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Forest Service page and recreation.gov: no hookups, vault toilets, drinking water (the FS page contradicts itself on water), first-come only. Added year-round season, 14-night limit (lifted in gun season) and that it is now a recreation.gov Scan & Pay site. Note corrected ('not on recreation.gov' is out of date) and field facts dropped. Fees left at the human-read $3 (see flag). Not stated: site count, rig length.
flags: Fee conflict: the entry's $3/night (Forest Service page: '$3 per vehicle for camping per night') vs recreation.gov's Scan & Pay rate table for facility 10391795, which lists 'Peak Season 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-31: Peak Campground (Primitive) $10'. The site is now paid through recreation.gov, so $10 may be the current charge; fees were human-read so left alone.
Missing phone: recreation.gov gives (850) 926-3561 (Wakulla Ranger District).
No storm closure posted for Mack Landing (Forest Service page 'Site Open'; forest alerts list no Isaias closure) as of 2026-10-21.
